findings.evidence: Lines 163 and 174 quantify over `a` versus `a b`, respectively. The naming convention requires descriptive conclusion-outward names and uses the function-name suffix `_injective`; Mathlib/Combinatorics/Quiver/Covering.lean:188 provides `Prefunctor.pathStar_injective` as the adjacent Quiver precedent.
findings.fix: Rename the closed-path result to `of_mapPath_self_injective` (or similarly explicit terminology) and reserve `of_mapPath_injective` for the all-endpoints hypothesis.
findings.issue: `of_mapPath_injective` advertises injectivity of `F.mapPath` generally, but assumes it only on closed paths; the stronger line 172 variant is then distinguished by the vague, nonstandard suffix `_of_all`.

summary: The pullback theorem names do not clearly distinguish closed-path injectivity from injectivity on all path types.
